sourceView: All four seen at 1:1 pixel crops on an opaque checkerboard; full original also opened. No game/browser/Native animation viewed.

raised.observed: narrow raised forewing V toward head, exposed narrow hindwing side slivers
raised.limits: Raised V is visible only as a 2D pose; actual above-body 3D wing height is an interpretation, not measured geometry.

spread.observed: broad lateral forewings and separate smaller rearward hindwing lobes
spread.limits: Exceeds requested60% cell width: alpha16 silhouette532/627=84.85%; alpha8 silhouette534/627=85.17%. Still inside cell and isolated from other meaningful art.

downstroke.observed: broad forewings swept backward toward tail, visibly different from spread
downstroke.limits: Exceeds60% cell width slightly: alpha16 silhouette392/627=62.52%. Backward V differs from lateral spread; 3D below-body trajectory is not proved by a static image.

folded.observed: compact wings close beside abdomen, pointed folded silhouette
folded.limits: Compact pointed silhouette is distinct from raised recovery; no in-game transition/continuous wing motion demonstrated.

anchorReview.kind: visible painted thorax center, manually selected
notes: Bodies have a comparable visible size and direction, but exact body pixels and cell-local thorax placement are not identical.
Cropping/anchor metadata can align visible thorax centers without image scaling; no actual sprite registration or runtime alignment was done.
Selected head/root/distal abdomen points are visible body samples, not exact shape extrema or a complete anatomy mask.
True wing hinge axes/3D lift are obscured and are not registered as observed joints.
